observations.finding: DMSO control f_9fbcadfb9d0d: dense confluent monolayer, >300 nuclei/field, uniform round-oval blue DAPI nuclei with smooth contours; green tubulin forms faint radial filament network; red F-actin faint cortical. Treated fields w_086098dd16 (1uM) and w_3c2d7256ae (10uM): markedly lower confluence, cells isolated/singlets and small clusters; measured cells 364 at 1uM and 210 at 10uM vs confluent control. No cell-count feature in top_deviations.

DNA (blue): treated nuclei markedly irregular, enlarged, lobed and frequently bi/multinucleated per cell - visible as 2-4 distinct blue masses within one green/red cytoplasm e.g. f_e49f75311a04 center-left cluster and lower center, f_3d278fa72a10 left-center elongated cell with 3-4 nuclei in line, f_169783cedcc2 lower-center and f_dd8e8b1b5262 center. Nuclei more elongated than round control.

DNA (blue): decrease in roundness/smoothness and increase in elongation quantified as nuc_form_factor z -38.5 to -47.9 (0.83-0.85 vs 0.917 DMSO), nuc_solidity z -35.7 to -57.2 (0.949-0.958 vs 0.972), nuc_eccentricity z +13.9 to +17.5 (0.69-0.71 vs 0.60). Visual irregular/lobed/elongated nuclei and frank multinucleation agree.

DNA (blue): frequent multinucleation quantified as frac_multinucleate_proxy z +17.5 at 1uM (0.644 vs 0.268) and +15.9 at 10uM (0.609 vs 0.268). Visually ~30-50% of cells contain 2+ nuclei vs rare in DMSO.

F-actin (red) read from composite: treated red signal brighter and more heterogeneous per cell with sharp peripheral/bundle/retraction-fiber contrast and spiky margins vs faint diffuse cortical red in DMSO. Consistent with act_mean z +14.7 to +18.1 (0.51-0.56 vs 0.29), act_std z +19.7 to +24.5 (0.16-0.18 vs 0.07), act_glcm_contrast z +21.6 to +27.6 (0.004 vs 0.001).

Beta-tubulin (green) read from composite: green filament network retained, not depolymerized or bundled, but appears more contrasted/textured within larger spread cells with bright yellow overlap in rounded mitotics. Consistent with tub_glcm_contrast z +14.4 to +16.0 (0.006 vs 0.002). No visible microtubule destabilizer (loss of green) or stabilizer (dense bundles) phenotype; not quantified beyond contrast.

Mitotic figures: increased bright yellow/white rounded cells with condensed blue chromosomes and intense green+red overlap (e.g. f_e49f75311a04 ~8/field, f_169783cedcc2 central cluster) vs 2-3/field in DMSO. No quantitative mitotic feature provided.

data.note:
Unblinded: emetine (PubChem CID 10219, BBBC021 structure agree; ChEMBL CHEMBL50588 no curated mechanism, e26) - BBBC021 annotates as Protein synthesis, prediction scored correct.

Initial call Aurora kinase inhibitors 0.54 was driven by Microscopist reports of lobed/bi-multinucleated cells and frac_multinucleate_proxy z~15-17. PI critique highlighted contradiction: NSC atlas 4/4 Protein synthesis cosine 0.88-0.94 (e9), and vision enlargement claim vs measured nuc_area z -1.9 to -8.2, cell_area z -7 to -11, frac_mitotic_like ~0. Requested direct describe_phenotype of reference neighbour fields (cycloheximide, anisomycin) failed - tool requires acquired wells (budget spent).

Free dose-responses rescued correction: nuc_dna_integrated rho -1.0 p=0 (e19), no large-nucleus/mitotic gain (e20,e21), cell_area shrinking (e22) - all opposite Aurora 4N/8N polyploidy expectation. Revised to Protein synthesis 0.62.

Literature: emetine inhibition of protein synthesis as mechanism of action (PMID:4347870) and classic protein synthesis/amnesia studies with emetine (PMID:191850). Residual lesson: frac_multinucleate_proxy/lobing is not Aurora-specific - shared by high-similarity Protein synthesis neighbours, explaining why vision alone overstated Aurora.

reflection.text:
Reflection as MuseCell Scientist - specimen unblinded as emetine, Truth Protein synthesis, Final call Protein synthesis p=0.62 correct.

What evidence got right:
- The quantitative atlas comparison was the strongest signal from the start and remained unanimous: e5 NSC Protein synthesis 2/2, k-neighbours 5/10 Protein synthesis; e9 NSC 4/4 wells, k-neighbours 5/10 Protein synthesis with cosine 0.88-0.94. This was correctly weighted in hypothesis 1 as Protein synthesis 0.45 vs Aurora 0.35, but should have been weighted higher given unanimity across independent wells.
- Dose-response of negative Aurora expectations was decisive after PI critique and correctly flipped the call. e19 nuc_dna_integrated rho=-1.00 p=0 (decrease, not increase expected for 4N/8N polyploidy), e15 nuc_area rho=-0.80, e22 cell_area rho=-0.80, with absolute z-scores nuc_area -1.9 to -8.2 and cell_area -7 to -11 across 0.1-30 uM. This directly contradicted vision claims of enlarged nuclei/cells. e20 frac_mitotic_like rho=+0.60 p=0.4 but absolute ~0, and e21 frac_large_nucleus rho=-0.40 p=0.6, both inconsistent with Aurora/Eg5 mitotic arrest and polyploid large-nucleus phenotype. e10 frac_multinucleate_proxy rho=-0.40 p=0.6 showed no dose dependence.

What misled us and why:
- Vision model e4 and e13 both returned 'Aurora kinase inhibitors' with 7 observations, density lower vs DMSO. This was over-weighted in update e17 to Aurora 0.55 vs Protein synthesis 0.32. The visual cue was supported by extreme morphology metrics that looked like lobed/multinucleated nuclei: e2 nuc_form_factor z=-38.5, nuc_solidity z=-35.7, act_glcm_contrast +21.6 at 1 uM; e3 nuc_solidity -57.2, form_factor -47.9 at 10 uM; e7 and e8 replicated this at 0.1 and 30 uM with solidity -30.4 to -38.2. We interpreted persistence across 300-fold dose range (e2,e3,e7,e8) as cytokinesis-failure polyploidy specific to Aurora, when the Review correctly noted this lobing/multinucleation-proxy may be shared by Protein synthesis atlas matches.
- We did not initially test the counter-hypothesis that top Protein synthesis neighbours share the same phenotype. The requested free experiment describe_phenotype on reference fields cycloheximide f_75b10ad68eec and anisomycin f_29f027d95008 failed with 'Field not in an acquired well' - a tool/budget constraint. We substituted free dose_response tests e19-e22, which salvaged the call but was indirect. Acquisition choice to sample 4 wells 0.1,1,10,30 uM was good for dose-response, but we measured size/DNA content too late.
- Hypothesis rationale in e18 overstated vision vs 4/4 NSC vote (0.54 vs 0.32). The pivot to e23 Protein synthesis 0.62 was only after forced quantitative check.

Why the miss resolved:
- PI critique that vision enlarged-nuclei/mitotics conflicted with measurements was validated. Once e19-e22 were run, Aurora expectations were systematically violated while Protein synthesis high similarity was retained.

Literature context:
- Unblinding lookup e25/e26 showed PubChem CID 10219 / ChEMBL CHEMBL50588 with no curated mechanism, but name/structure agree with BBBC021 emetine. Literature from this run supports emetine as protein synthesis inhibitor PMID 4347870 and PMID 191850, consistent with atlas-based call, not a curated kinase.

Lesson: when NSC vote is unanimous 4/4 with high cosine, vision-based 'multinucleation' must be calibrated by side-by-side neighbour phenotyping and by orthogonal size/DNA-content metrics before invoking Aurora/Eg5. Future runs should prioritize early nuc_area, nuc_dna_integrated, and frac_large_nucleus dose-responses alongside atlas vote, and budget for reference-well acquisition for direct visual comparison. No clinical interpretation warranted; this is screening phenotype only.

Negative DNA content / size trends contradicting Aurora polyploidy enlargement
what_was_wrong: Over-weighting vision Aurora reports vs unanimous quantitative atlas
Interpreting extreme nuc_solidity/form_factor as Aurora-specific multinucleation without neighbour control

## Reflection

Reflection as MuseCell Scientist - specimen unblinded as emetine, Truth Protein synthesis, Final call Protein synthesis p=0.62 correct.

What evidence got right:
- The quantitative atlas comparison was the strongest signal from the start and remained unanimous: e5 NSC Protein synthesis 2/2, k-neighbours 5/10 Protein synthesis; e9 NSC 4/4 wells, k-neighbours 5/10 Protein synthesis with cosine 0.88-0.94. This was correctly weighted in hypothesis 1 as Protein synthesis 0.45 vs Aurora 0.35, but should have been weighted higher given unanimity across independent wells.
- Dose-response of negative Aurora expectations was decisive after PI critique and correctly flipped the call. e19 nuc_dna_integrated rho=-1.00 p=0 (decrease, not increase expected for 4N/8N polyploidy), e15 nuc_area rho=-0.80, e22 cell_area rho=-0.80, with absolute z-scores nuc_area -1.9 to -8.2 and cell_area -7 to -11 across 0.1-30 uM. This directly contradicted vision claims of enlarged nuclei/cells. e20 frac_mitotic_like rho=+0.60 p=0.4 but absolute ~0, and e21 frac_large_nucleus rho=-0.40 p=0.6, both inconsistent with Aurora/Eg5 mitotic arrest and polyploid large-nucleus phenotype. e10 frac_multinucleate_proxy rho=-0.40 p=0.6 showed no dose dependence.

What misled us and why:
- Vision model e4 and e13 both returned 'Aurora kinase inhibitors' with 7 observations, density lower vs DMSO. This was over-weighted in update e17 to Aurora 0.55 vs Protein synthesis 0.32. The visual cue was supported by extreme morphology metrics that looked like lobed/multinucleated nuclei: e2 nuc_form_factor z=-38.5, nuc_solidity z=-35.7, act_glcm_contrast +21.6 at 1 uM; e3 nuc_solidity -57.2, form_factor -47.9 at 10 uM; e7 and e8 replicated this at 0.1 and 30 uM with solidity -30.4 to -38.2. We interpreted persistence across 300-fold dose range (e2,e3,e7,e8) as cytokinesis-failure polyploidy specific to Aurora, when the Review correctly noted this lobing/multinucleation-proxy may be shared by Protein synthesis atlas matches.
- We did not initially test the counter-hypothesis that top Protein synthesis neighbours share the same phenotype. The requested free experiment describe_phenotype on reference fields cycloheximide f_75b10ad68eec and anisomycin f_29f027d95008 failed with 'Field not in an acquired well' - a tool/budget constraint. We substituted free dose_response tests e19-e22, which salvaged the call but was indirect. Acquisition choice to sample 4 wells 0.1,1,10,30 uM was good for dose-response, but we measured size/DNA content too late.
- Hypothesis rationale in e18 overstated vision vs 4/4 NSC vote (0.54 vs 0.32). The pivot to e23 Protein synthesis 0.62 was only after forced quantitative check.

Why the miss resolved:
- PI critique that vision enlarged-nuclei/mitotics conflicted with measurements was validated. Once e19-e22 were run, Aurora expectations were systematically violated while Protein synthesis high similarity was retained.

Literature context:
- Unblinding lookup e25/e26 showed PubChem CID 10219 / ChEMBL CHEMBL50588 with no curated mechanism, but name/structure agree with BBBC021 emetine. Literature from this run supports emetine as protein synthesis inhibitor PMID 4347870 and PMID 191850, consistent with atlas-based call, not a curated kinase.

Lesson: when NSC vote is unanimous 4/4 with high cosine, vision-based 'multinucleation' must be calibrated by side-by-side neighbour phenotyping and by orthogonal size/DNA-content metrics before invoking Aurora/Eg5. Future runs should prioritize early nuc_area, nuc_dna_integrated, and frac_large_nucleus dose-responses alongside atlas vote, and budget for reference-well acquisition for direct visual comparison. No clinical interpretation warranted; this is screening phenotype only.

What was right:
- NSC vote Protein synthesis 4/4 with high cosine similarity and k-neighbour 5/10 support
- Negative DNA content / size trends contradicting Aurora polyploidy enlargement

What was wrong or missed:
- Over-weighting vision Aurora reports vs unanimous quantitative atlas
- Interpreting extreme nuc_solidity/form_factor as Aurora-specific multinucleation without neighbour control

Proposed next experiment: Acquire reference wells of Protein synthesis class for side-by-side imaging plus puromycin incorporation and DNA content flow to resolve proxy vs true polyploidy
